title: Backward erasure
statement: For Boolean words $w$ and $u$, starting in eraser state $1$ with $u$ on the tape and its head at displacement $|u|-1$, after exactly $|u|+1$ steps the machine is in state $2$ with a blank tape and its head at displacement $0$. The input remains $w$ and the output is empty.
replaced:
From the eraser's backward state with the word $u$ and head at displacement
$\abs{u} - 1$, exactly $\abs{u} + 1$ steps erase every cell of $u$ right to
left and restore the head to the origin, reaching the return state with a
blank tape.
